OUR PROCESS

How It Works

From consultation to delivery, we make your custom fashion journey seamless

1

Connect

Reach out via Instagram or WhatsApp. Share your vision, fabric preferences, and measurements.

2

Design

We collaborate on designs, finalize patterns, and confirm fabric details and pricing.

3

Create

Our skilled artisans bring your outfit to life with meticulous attention to every detail.

4

Deliver

Quality check, final fitting adjustments, and delivery of your perfectly crafted garment.

OUR STORY

Where Passion Meets Craft

SriMed LABEL was born from a deep love for Indian textiles and the transformative power of well-crafted clothing. What started as a small passion project has grown into a bespoke fashion house trusted by clients across the country.

We believe every garment should tell a story — your story. Whether it's a lehenga for your big day, a blouse that fits like a dream, or giving new life to your grandmother's saree through upcycling, we pour heart into every stitch.

Our commitment to quality, sustainability, and personalized service sets us apart. We're not just tailors; we're storytellers, memory-keepers, and dream-weavers working to make you look and feel extraordinary.
